verdict.rationale: Sketch documents `sketchtool`, a first-party command-line interface that can "create assets with a single command". That is a programmatic export surface an agent could invoke. Sketch also documents a built-in MCP server through which AI clients can "interact directly with Sketch", but the evidence never says that MCP surface renders or exports images, and the sketchtool mention is a single thin line. Missing for 10: documented export formats (PNG/SVG/PDF/production), screenshot or render capability via the MCP server, export parameters such as scale or slices, and hands-on or independent corroboration of agent-driven export.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can render and export designs — screenshots, images, or production formats — through a documented programmatic surface

citations.quote: Create assets with a single command with the Sketch command-line interface `sketchtool`.
Sketch includes a built-in MCP Server, a lightweight local-only web server that lets AI clients like ChatGPT or Claude interact directly with Sketch.
Integrate Sketch into your workflows and server applications, on any platform.
